objectives.description: Build git-backed fixture helper (temp git repo, specs/ dir, committed baseline)
Negative fixture: raw jq-composed rejection, more removed than added
Positive fixture: identical mutation with --allow-artifact-removal accepted
Untyped-entry fixture: drop two untyped entries, add none, FAIL
Scoped-flag fixture: wrong-type opt-in still FAILs
Resolve validator explicitly and assert it contains the new check identifier
objectives.note: Added a dedicated D5_VALIDATOR_CANDIDATES resolution (source-store-first) that greps each candidate for the 'Check D5' identifier before trusting it; loudly info()-skips the D5 block if none qualify.

scope_hypothesis_result: Plan estimated seven new fixture cases; the actual implementation produced six distinct D5 pass() assertions (negative, positive, regression, pure-append, untyped, scoped) -- the plan's Tasks list itself only enumerates six named fixtures, so the Scope Hypothesis's 'seven' figure was itself an overcount at authoring time. Suite PASSED total went from 8 (pre-existing) to 14 (post-change), a delta of 6, matching the six D5 cases. All pre-existing 8 cases still pass (no regression). Reporting the real number (6) per the phase's own instruction.
